items.title: Show HN: News Blocklist - a DNS blocklist of 14k news and current-affairs sites (Source: hnrss.org | Category: Hacker News)
items.content_text: A little while ago I built (vibed) a tiny Mac app to block websites via the hosts file. By default it imported some fairly popular adult filtering lists as well as social media etc. It has been very effective; it would only take a few moments to switch off but it is enough of an interruption to often make me re-evaluate and proceed on. I have a particular distain for current affairs and have found "the news" addictive for years, clearly at the detriment to my own mental health and sanity. So, in a similar vein to the other lists I found, I have created a fairly comprehensive list of news sites that can be imported/used as you see fit. To state the obvious, the absolute vast majority of the work was done via Claude and a small army of sub-agents. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=50611026 Points: 2 # Comments: 0
